audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer describes lane difficulty in template language ('Track Ki Burst', 'her engage CC') with no numbers, so it never tells you how long the safe window actually is.
audit.why: Riot kit: Ki Burst 11/10/9/8/7s. Riven's all-in without her stun is dodgeable; with it, it is not. The gap between 11s and 7s is the whole lane.
audit.corrected: Name the 11s rank-1 / 7s rank-5 window as the trade trigger.

audit.why: Content spikes read levels 2-3 (Acceleration Gate), first item (Eclipse), level 6 (Blade of the Exile, 120/90/60s) and two items as her inversion point — consistent with her scaling and Jayce's falloff.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere mentions that Valor's shield absorbs a Shock Blast, which is the single interaction that decides whether your poke lands.
audit.why: Riot kit: Valor (E) is a dash that grants a shield, 10/9/8/7/6s. Shock Blast is a projectile that detonates on the first enemy hit, so a shielded Riven eats the orb for nothing and dashes in on your cooldown.
audit.corrected: Bait Valor with a cheap ungated orb, then fire the accelerated one into the 10s window.
